vuln_statements.explanation: This function handles CPU frequency limit updates with shared global state access. The guard() mechanism may not properly synchronize concurrent access during policy changes, creating potential race conditions when multiple CPUs update frequency limits simultaneously.

This wrapper function accesses shared cpudata structure through all_cpu_data array without proper locking around the entire operation sequence, potentially allowing use-after-free if cpudata is freed while this function executes.
